source_inconsistencies.i-1: Question visibly prints 'in zones' without a separate zone S label; solution uses zone S. Preserve question wording without supplying a missing condition.
source_inconsistencies.i-5: Question says 'in the year' without naming years; solution uses 2009 and 2010. Preserve both source forms.
source_inconsistencies.iii-revenue-context: At 180 DPI the July commission cell visibly prints rupee00. Printed solutions1 and3 use40000. Retain literal00, deliberate em-dash missing cells, and both explanatory notes; no guessed repair.
source_inconsistencies.iii-solution-9: Printed marker9 has no period and is manually bound. First formula is(120+158)/2=139; last value1165.43 is rounded in print to1150. Preserve the printed rounding and option/key(a).
source_inconsistencies.i-solution-18: Printed solution says all the 5 cities but its sum lists all six cities. Preserve the literal statement and sum.
source_inconsistencies.ii-solution-20: Printed salary sum is followed by rupee170 lakh, while the percentage expression uses denominator1710. Preserve both printed numbers.
source_inconsistencies.ii-solution-23: Printed 2011 calculation includes 169/19% after (80/950)x100%; preserve the printed169 rather than recomputing.
source_inconsistencies.iii-solution-6: Printed run-difference formula uses a multiplication sign before48x/100 in the line with264x/100 and216x/100; preserve operators as printed.
source_inconsistencies.iii-question-7: Question7 asks minimum runs in the28th match, but solution7 computes E's strike rate120.3125 and key selects(d), whose option text is120.31. Preserve the source mismatch; do not substitute139 or change the key.
source_inconsistencies.iii-solution-14: Printed sum for countryT is60+50+55+110+110=376; next line uses375/5=75, while table2001T is100. Preserve every printed number and final13 7/11 percent.
source_inconsistencies.iii-solution-20: Printed final solution value is53 1/2 percent whereas key(d)/option(d) is53 1/3. Preserve both; do not change the denominator.
source_inconsistencies.iii-solution-25: Printed Q-publisher line uses79/100 +33800=26702, not a multiplication sign. Preserve the literal operator and conclusion.
